senses.gloss:
वैंशतिक वैंशतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विंशति),
purchased with twenty.

वैनतक वैनतक, अम्, n. a vessel for
holding or pouring out ghee (used at sacrifices).

वैनतेय वैनतेय, अस्, m. (fr. वि-नता), N. of
Garuḍa (as son of Vinatā); of Aruṇa (elder brother
of Garuḍa).

वैनयिक वैनयिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-नय),
relating to moral conduct or discipline; enforcing
proper behaviour; performed by the officers of
criminal justice, magisterial; (अस्), m. a chariot em-
ployed in military exercises, a war-carriage.

वैनाशिक वैनाशिक, अस्, m. (fr. वि-नाश), a
dependant, subject, slave; a spider; an astrologer;
(अम्), n. the twenty-third Nakṣatra or constellation
from that under which any one is born.

वैनीतक वैनीतक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. वि-
नीत), an indirect means of conveyance (as a porter
carrying a litter or dooly, a palanquin-bearer, horse
dragging a carriage, &c.).

वैन्दव वैन्दव, अस्, m. (fr. विन्दु), a pa-
tronymic from Vindu.
वैन्दवि, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe.
वैन्दवीय, अस्, m. a prince of the Vaindavis.

वैन्य वैन्य, अस्, m. (fr. वेन), a patronymic
of Pṛthī (Ved.); of Pṛthu (author of the hymn
Ṛg-veda X. 148, who is probably to be identified
with Pṛthī); of king Pṛthu [cf. वैण्य]; N. of a
deity (?).
—वैन्य-दत्त, अस्, m. a proper N.

वैनत्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-नत), submissiveness,
modesty.
वैनायक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Gaṇeśa.
